knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A check clean inspects every aspect and cleans only the parts that fail, so the element ends in the same state a full clean would leave it.
Cleaning an element that is clean and unused adds cost without a matching infection control benefit.
The SA standard requires the standard clean routinely, irrespective of how clean the element appears.

practicalCriteria: Learner inspects a sample element with a pass only when each aspect is checked and only the failing aspects are cleaned
Learner records the clean type for three sample elements against the schedule, with all three correct
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Schedule extract with the clean type recorded
stopWorkCriteria: The schedule is missing and no clean type can be confirmed
